meta.source: royalvision.com.pk/new — live site CSS (custom --rv-* variables and widget styles), read 11 Nov 2026

tokens.name: rv-brand
tokens.usage: Primary brand plum. Primary buttons, links, counters, icons, active states. White text on it is 8.0:1; as text on white or rv-blush it passes for any size.

tokens.name: rv-logo
tokens.usage: The plum inside the logo artwork and its SINCE 2009 bar. Use for logo-matched fills; white text on it is 7.4:1.

tokens.name: rv-main
tokens.usage: Bright magenta accent. Gradient end, hover glow, highlighted words in headings. As text on white 5.2:1, fine for body sizes.

tokens.name: rv-main-dark
tokens.usage: Pressed and hover state of rv-brand buttons. White text on it is 9.3:1.

tokens.name: rv-main-light
tokens.usage: Lighter magenta used in a few hover tints. Not for small text.

tokens.name: rv-light
tokens.usage: Gradient start (135deg rv-light to rv-main) on hero buttons and badges. 3.9:1 on white, so never small text on white; white text on it only at 19px bold or larger.

tokens.name: rv-dark
tokens.usage: Headings and dark text on surface and rv-blush (16.9:1).

tokens.name: rv-hero-ink
tokens.usage: Hero title colour on the home page.

tokens.name: rv-text
tokens.usage: Body copy and descriptions on surface (5.0:1) and rv-blush (4.7:1).

tokens.name: rv-slate
tokens.usage: Secondary text that needs more weight than rv-text, on surface (10.4:1).

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page and card background.

tokens.name: rv-blush
tokens.usage: Soft section background; sections fade from surface to rv-blush (180deg).

tokens.name: rv-blush-2
tokens.usage: Chips, icon wells and small tinted panels on surface.

tokens.name: rv-tint
tokens.usage: rv-brand at 10%: card borders, hairlines and soft fills on surface.

tokens.name: rv-grid
tokens.usage: The faint 1px graph-paper grid drawn behind hero and section backgrounds.

tokens.name: rv-green
tokens.usage: WhatsApp brand green, gradient start of WhatsApp buttons. White text on it alone is only 2.0:1; always pair with wa-dark.

tokens.name: wa-dark
tokens.usage: WhatsApp gradient end (135deg rv-green to wa-dark). White text on it is 4.1:1, so keep button labels 14px bold or larger.

tokens.name: yt-red
tokens.usage: YouTube buttons and the video section only.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between chips and small inline items.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Default gap inside cards and button rows (most used gap on the site).

tokens.name: space-18
tokens.usage: Card padding and gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-48
tokens.usage: Vertical padding of a section block (48px top and bottom, 16px sides on phones).

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Inputs, small cards, icon wells.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Standard cards (most used card radius).

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Large panels: eligibility checker, journey timeline, hero cards.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Every button, badge and chip. Brand buttons are always pills.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Resting card shadow.

tokens.name: shadow-raised
tokens.usage: Hovered card and floating panels.
